findings.body:
**Include socket activation in dependency discovery.**

In `unit-live-binding.py`, Line 94 omits `Service=`. An installed `outside.socket` with `[Socket] Service=crq-review.service` therefore passes the dependency scan. Systemd uses this directive to select the service to activate. ([freedesktop.org](https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/252/systemd.socket.html))

The filename also falls outside the prefix-filtered manager queries. With otherwise valid observations, `discover` reports `supported=true` despite an undeclared activator. Parse `Service=` references and classify references to expected units as foreign.
findings.title: Include socket activation in dependency discovery.

findings.body:
**Match dependency values after expanding unit specifiers, or refuse them.**

`CRQ_NAME_RE.findall` at `apps/crq-python/ops/unit-live-binding.py:622` searches only literal text. An undeclared instance file such as `outside@crq-review.service` that contains `Wants=%i.service` contributes no name. systemd expands `%i` to `crq-review` when it loads the instance, so the unit can add a dependency on the selected service. Discovery then can report `supported=true`. The filename does not start with the selected prefix checked at `unit-live-binding.py` (`prefix = unit.split(".")[0]`), and the manager queries use the `crq-review*` pattern, so neither check reports it.

Refuse undeclared dependency values that contain a `%` specifier. Discovery then reports an incomplete result, so the topology is not treated as supported. This is conservative: an unrelated undeclared unit that uses a specifier also makes discovery incomplete.

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
-                            for name in CRQ_NAME_RE.findall(match.group("value")):
+                            value = match.group("value")
+                            if not source_declared and "%" in value:
+                                return ("dependency scan cannot expand a specifier "
+                                        "in an undeclared unit: " + str(path))
+                            for name in CRQ_NAME_RE.findall(value):
```

</details>
findings.title: Match dependency values after expanding unit specifiers, or refuse them.
